report.summary: A code deployment (chg-9890) to payments-api at 14:02 UTC introduced a NullPointerException in PaymentIntentValidator.java, causing payment failures starting at 14:03 UTC.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Code deploy bug in payments-api v2.14.0

supporting.note: Deployment of payments-api v2.14.0 occurred at 14:02 UTC, just one minute before symptoms started.
Error rate spiked sharply at 14:03 UTC reaching 19.1%.
Error rate spiked at 14:03 UTC reaching 5.31% due to downstream failures.
payments-api logs show NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.validate starting at 14:03:05 UTC.
mobile-bff logs show upstream payments-api 500 errors starting at 14:03:01 UTC.

ranked_hypotheses.title: External UPI or NPCI gateway outage

contradicting.note: upi-gateway error rate remained entirely normal around ~0.2% - 0.34% with no anomaly during the incident window.

facts.text: payments-api v2.14.0 was deployed at 2026-10-02T14:02:00+00:00 with changes to payment-intent validation.
Error rates for payments-api and mobile-bff increased sharply starting at 14:03:00+00:00.
payments-api logged NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 starting at 14:03:05+00:00.
mobile-bff logged upstream payments-api 500 responses starting at 14:03:01+00:00.
upi-gateway error rates and latency exhibited no anomalies throughout the window.

assumptions: Mobile app clients sent payment payloads that triggered the null pointer condition in the newly introduced validation code.

timeline.event: Error rate anomaly begins on mobile-bff and payments-api
mobile-bff logs first upstream 500 error from payments-api
payments-api logs first NullPointerException in PaymentIntentValidator
Incident reported by on-call SRE Priya

recommended_actions.action: Rollback payments-api from v2.14.0 to v2.13.4
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly resolves the bad deployment causing widespread payment transaction failures.

recommended_actions.action: Fix null pointer check in PaymentIntentValidator.java
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensure payer_vpa validation robustly handles null inputs before re-releasing the refactored validation logic.
